summary: Full E2E testing of AI Smart Career Analyzer. Backend: 7/7 pytest tests passed (root, analyze_resume text+file+empty, get_questions, evaluate_answer including empty). Frontend: complete user journey verified - home form -> resume analysis (score 100/100 with 6 skills detected) -> start interview (5 LLM questions loaded via Claude Sonnet 4.5) -> mode toggles (text/voice/video) work -> timer counts down from 30 -> all 5 answers submitted -> navigates to /final -> resume/interview/overall score cards + 5 question breakdown rows shown -> restart returns to home. No critical issues.

issues: Eyebrow text 'AI · Career Intelligence Suite' rendered as 'CAREFR' in some font/contrast snapshot - very low rose contrast on dark crimson bg makes it appear smudged; consider increasing opacity from text-rose-400/80

critical_code_review_comments: Backend: LlmChat session reuse - each get_questions/evaluate_answer creates new chat session (fine for stateless). Good fallback handling on LLM errors.

InterviewPage useEffect dependency: submitAnswer in timer auto-submit useEffect uses eslint-disable - acceptable but could capture stale answer/index closure. Currently works because timer resets per question.
Frontend: axios calls lack request timeouts; long LLM calls (30-60s) rely on default. Consider adding explicit timeout for resilience.
MongoDB client created but never used (no persistence) - dead code, could be removed.
compute_resume_score caps at 100 correctly; SKILL_KEYWORDS regex uses word boundaries - good.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 4 pages functional. Backend stateless (no DB writes). LLM (Claude Sonnet 4.5) returns valid JSON for both endpoints. Note: when answers are generic/nonsense, LLM correctly scores them 0 - this is expected behavior, not a bug. Voice mode requires Chrome/Edge Web Speech API; video mode requires camera permission - both UI toggles verified working. Test file at /app/backend/tests/test_career_analyzer.py is reusable for regression.
